This feature is a fantastic tool for women seeking to understand their bodies better and manage their health more effectively.

Now, you can focus on your day, not your charger.

Rated with IP68 waterproof protection, this smartwatch is designed to withstand the toughest conditions. It’s built to be water-resistant and dustproof, allowing you to wear it with confidence in almost any situation—whether you’re poolside or diving into a workout session.

This fitness tracker watch is more than just a health and fitness tracker. With multiple functions, it’s your ultimate personal assistant. Enjoy features like a Timer, Stopwatch, Alarm Clock, and even a Find Your Phone option when your phone goes missing. Plus, you can control your music on-the-go with the Music Control feature, making it easy to switch tracks without reaching for your phone. 
Stay ahead of the weather with the Weat her Forecast feature, and keep distractions at bay with Don’t Disturb Mode, which lets you block unnecessary alerts whenever you need focus time. You can also adjust the screen’s brightness for the perfect view in any lighting condition and even use the Camera Control feature to snap hands-free photos.

Product Description
The 2024 Latest Smart Fitness Watch: Your Everyday Health Companion and More! 
Are you ready to elevate your lifestyle with cutting-edge technology, sleek design, and comprehensive health tracking? Meet this 2024 latest smart fitness watch, meticulously designed for today’s tech-savvy and health-conscious individuals. This fitness tracker watch does so much more than just tell time—it’s your personal fitness coach, health tracker, communication hub, and lifestyle assistant—all wrapped up into one powerful wearable device. 
Whether you’re hitting the gym, managing a busy workday, or just looking to stay healthier and more organized, this smartwatch will become an indispensable part of your daily life. And with its long battery life, waterproof design, and vast array of customizable features, it’s built to keep up with you every step of the way. 
Stunning Visual and Operational Experience 
Ultra HD Full Touch Color Screen 
The moment you set eyes on the ultra-HD full touch color screen, you’ll realize this is no ordinary watch. With crystal-clear visuals, a vibrant color palette, and a smooth user interface, this smartwatch brings every interaction to life. Its high-resolution display ensures every swipe, tap, and notification is easy to read, whether you’re indoors or out in bright sunlight. 
More Than 200 Dial Options 
Love personalization? Choose from more than 200 dial options! From classic and elegant to fun and modern, you can switch up the look of your watch to match your style, mood, or occasion. You’ll never have to settle for one look again! 
Comprehensive Health Tracking 
24/7 Heart Rate Monitoring 
Your heart is the center of your well-being, and this smartwatch monitors it continuously. With 24/7 heart rate monitoring, you can stay on top of your cardiovascular health no matter where life takes you. Whether you're resting, working out, or somewhere in between, this advanced heart rate sensor provides accurate, real-time insights into your heart's performance. 
Blood Oxygen Monitoring 
In today’s fast-paced world, understanding your body’s oxygen levels is essential for maintaining overall wellness. The fitness tracker for women and men allows you to keep track of your blood oxygen saturation, an important indicator of your respiratory health. Perfect for athletes, mountain climbers, or anyone who wants to monitor their oxygen levels on-the-go! 
Blood Pressure Monitoring 
The blood pressure monitoring feature on the smart fitness watches helps you keep an eye on one of the most critical indicators of heart health. This functionality enables you to measure your blood pressure anytime, anywhere, giving you valuable insights into how your body reacts to daily activities. 
Sleep Tracking 
Waking up tired after a full night of sleep? The sleep tracker is here to help. By monitoring your sleep stages—light sleep, deep sleep, and REM—this feature provides you with detailed insights into your nightly rest. It helps you understand your sleep quality and offers recommendations on how to improve your overall sleep health. Start your days feeling refreshed, energized, and ready to conquer the world! 
Stay Connected with Calls andMessages Notification 
Stay in the loop, even when you’re on the go. With calls and messages notifications, you’ll never miss an important call, text, or app notification again. Receive notifications from social media platforms like Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and more—right on your wrist. Whether it's a quick glance at an incoming call or checking your messages discreetly during a meeting, this feature ensures that you’re always connected without needing to constantly check your phone. 
All-Day Activity Tracking and 128 Exercise Modes: Designed to Motivate You 
Track Your Fitness Journey with 128 Exercise Modes 
Whether you're a casual walker or an elite athlete, the 128 exercise modes tracking feature has something for everyone. This smartwatch is designed to accurately track a wide variety of exercises, from running and cycling to yoga, swimming, and strength training. Whatever your workout style, the fitness trackers adapt to your needs, giving you real-time data on your performance and helping you stay motivated. 
Each activity is analyzed through advanced sensors, providing you with metrics such as calories burned, steps taken, distance traveled, and heart rate during the exercise. Sync your data with the App and watch yourself reach new fitness milestones! 
All-Day Activity Tracking for a Healthier You 
Even when you’re not working out, this fitness watch works for you. With All-Day Activity Tracking, every step counts toward a healthier lifestyle. It tracks your steps, calories burned, distance covered, and active minutes throughout the day. You can set daily activity goals and watch your progress in real-time, pushing you to stay active and fit. Whether you're walking to work or taking a leisurely stroll in the park, this health activity tracker watch is there to keep you moving. 
Mutiple Notifications and Reminders 
Women’s Health: Menstrual Period Reminder 
For women, this heath fitness watch takes health tracking a step further with its Menstrual Period Reminder feature. It helps you track your menstrual cycle and provides helpful reminders for the different phases, ensuring you're always informed and prepared. This feature is a fantastic tool for women seeking to understand their bodies better and manage their health more effectively. 
Drinking Water Reminder 
It’s easy to forget to drink water during a busy day or while focusing on work. But now, with the Drinking Water Reminder, your smartwatch ensures you stay hydrated. Set up reminders that prompt you to drink water at regular intervals, keeping your body hydrated and your energy levels high. 
Sedentary Reminder 
If you’re sitting for too long, the sedentary reminder will nudge you to stand up, stretch, and move around. These gentle reminders help promote better posture, circulation, and overall well-being. 
Your Daily Assistant: Multiple Functions to Simplify Your Life 
Long Battery Life: Power Through Your Day 
There’s nothing worse than your device dying halfway through the day. Thankfully, the long battery life of this smart watch ensures that you stay powered up for days on a single charge. With up to 7-12 days of battery life (depending on usage), you can enjoy uninterrupted access to all the features you love without constantly worrying about recharging. Now, you can focus on your day, not your charger. 
IP68 Waterproof: Ready for Anything 
Whether you’re swimming, caught in the rain, or just washing your hands, you don’t have to worry about damaging your fitness watch. Rated with IP68 waterproof protection, this smartwatch is designed to withstand the toughest conditions. It’s built to be water-resistant and dustproof, allowing you to wear it with confidence in almost any situation—whether you’re poolside or diving into a workout session. 
Multiple Functions to Simplify Your Life 
This fitness tracker watch is more than just a health and fitness tracker. With multiple functions, it’s your ultimate personal assistant. Enjoy features like a Timer, Stopwatch, Alarm Clock, and even a Find Your Phone option when your phone goes missing. Plus, you can control your music on-the-go with the Music Control feature, making it easy to switch tracks without reaching for your phone. 
Stay ahead of the weather with the Weat her Forecast feature, and keep distractions at bay with Don’t Disturb Mode, which lets you block unnecessary alerts whenever you need focus time. You can also adjust the screen’s brightness for the perfect view in any lighting condition and even use the Camera Control feature to snap hands-free photos.

Product Description
Warm Tips: How to Charge & Connect Bluetooth successfully 
1. How to be successfully charged fitness tracker? 
1)When you first get the fitness tracker watch,if you long press the rectangle touch button (on the bottom of screen) for 5 seconds and it still cannot be turned on,it means that there is out of power.Please remove the wristband on the side of the touch screen,plug into any USB power,charger for 30 minute and touch the button for 3 seconds to activate. 
2)The wristband length of the slim fitness tracker watch can be adjusted from a minimum of 120mm to a maximum of 210mm. It is suitable fits most people's wrists. 
Note: Many friends said that charging failed, because it was actually plugged in backwards! Check below 3 points to confirm successfully charged. 
1)Only one side with METAL PIECE can be charged 2)When we pulg in metal piece charging side together with METAL side of USB port for charging the fitness tracker correctly, the fitness tracker will vibrate once . 3) the charging icon (green) will show on screen (See below Charging Guide picture or Video on the left side of listing) if not, pls turn the fitness tracker into another face and plug again. 
2. How to be successfully connect Bluetooth? 
Ensure both the watch and the Runmefit App are downloaded on smartphone and updated to the latest versions. （Compatible mobile phone system: Android5.0 (inclusive) or above, IOS9.0 (inclusive) or above,Bluethoth 5.2 (not Compatible with PC,Ipad,Tablet)
Make sure fitness tracker and the Bluetooth settings of the smartphone are turned on and . The Bluetooth distance of fitness tracker is 10m(32.8 feet).
Activate the GPS on your phone and open all the realted authority of app (grant location permission to the Runmefit App)
Open the app and check if it automatically connects. If not, it may be due to the Runmefit App not running properly in the background on your phone. For Android phones, add Runmefit App to the list of protected background applications. If there are any other activity restrictions for the Runmefit App, please address and remove them.
If you still cannot reconnect, try the following steps: 
a. Restart your phone's Bluetooth and attempt to reconnect. b. Restart the fitness tracker and attempt to reconnect. c. Restart your phone by Runmefit APP-"Devices" ,click"reconnect " or after 5 seconds it will auto connect. d. If it doesn't, open Runmefit APP-"Devices" -"Unbind" firstly then delete pair information, then research tracker name and re-pair the devices in the app( tracker is always turn on).Pair and Bind fitness tracker must be made in theRunmefit App, not the phone bluetooth setting.( Also it suited for the Bluetooth connection is disconnected) 
If none of the above methods resolve the issue, consider resetting the watch to factory settings. Check if the paired watch still exists in the Bluetooth settings of your phone; if it does, delete the pairing information and then attempt to pair again. 
3.How to connect my fitness tracker with phone and pair in Runmefit APP? A:Turn on the bluetooth of smartphone；Go to App sotre or Google play( Remind :other 3rd party software platform may need pay money for “Runmefit”) Our Runmefit is free on App store and Google play ; Search Runmefit(Remind pls download “Runmefit” instead of “Runmifit” .There is different letter in the middle .It is“Me” not “Mi” ,like the icon as below; Meanwhile,ensure the battery is fully charged of fitness tracker and open fitness tracker ,make sure the tracker close to the phone ; Tap the “+”at the right top of App and find your device “S5”then select”pair” and waiting . It can pair successfully. (Pair must be made in the App, not the phone bluetooth setting) Noted:This activity tracker requires iOS 9.0 & Android 4.4 above, Bluetooth 5.2 (Smartphone only, not compatible with iPad, PC or Tablet) To ensure “Runmefit”APP can track your data ,pls open related authority of app in your phone and keep app working in backage even screen closed. Please read the manual for the reason why your app can't work in the backstage. 
Customize Main Interface 
You can choose from the fitness tracker face market to customize main interface,or you can put your favorite photos put it into the dial. 
The adjustment of wristband ,mininum is 4.7inch and maximum is 7.9 inch with 0.96inch TFT screen, weight is 0.84OZ 
IP68 Waterproof 
The fitness tracker with IP68 waterproof resistant, it can totally meets your daily use, such as washing hands, sweating,rain. (Note : hot showers and saunas,swimming are not recommended) 
Call&Message Notification 
You can view call, text, and all the other notifications including Facebook,WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter on fitness watches for women.It will let you never miss any important calls & message when you turn on message notification in Runmefit APP. 
Sleep Monitoring 
Wear the fitness tracker to go to bed, the sleep monitor will analyze your deep sleep , light sleep and awake time. Please note that the monitoring data only show on APP and should be for reference only and does not replace a doctor's advice 
Take Pictures Remotely 
You can connect your phone and take photos through the remote control of the fitness watches for women.It's also easy to take pictures from a distance 
USB Charge 
The fitness tracker design and plug it into the USB interface to charge.You can get rid of the tedious charging cable,You can charge the fitness watches for women with either:( see charging guide picture) 
1.Any phone or table USB Power Adapter 
2.USB port on PC(Note:Charge the fitness tracker on PC USB port may take longer time) 
3.Wall charger or power strip with USB port 
FAQ: 
Q1.Why the fitness tracker could not be turn on? 
When you first get the fitness watches for women,if you long press the rectangle touch button for 5 seconds and it still cannot be turned on,it means that there is out of power.Please remove the wrisband on the side of the touch screen,plug into any USB power,charger for 30 minute,or touch the button for 3 seconds to activate. 
Q2.Why the fitness tracker could not be charged? Only one side with METAL PIECE can be charged . When we pulg in metal charging piecer together with METAL side of USB port for charging the fitness tracker correctly, the fitness tracker will vibrate once and the charging icon (green) will show on screen (See below Charging Guide picture or video on left side of listing) 
Q3.How to set the fitness tracker watch date and time? 
1.Please connect the fitness tracker watch with your Phone by downloading Runmefit APP firstly. 2.The fitness tracker watch will automatically synchronize the time and date your phone after binding. 3.When the tracker is out of power,there may be an error in the tracker time.After the battery is fully charged,please connect your phone and,it will automatically synchronize the time to your tracker.If not, Swipe your finger down the top to update the “home” of Runmefit APP. 
Q4.Why the call notification was turn on,the tracker does not vibrate when my phone receives the call? 
Please confirm the Bluetooth of phone is turned on and linked with the tracker,then check if the Runmefit APP is working(click "Devices"--> "S5" is Connected , "Notification"->"Turn on all notifications") If you dont’ want to receive message notification,turn it off and click[Devices]- [Do not disturb mode]-open Do not disturb all day or at regular intevals. 
Q5.Is the step count data inaccrate? 
-1)Input your Personal informations such as gender, birthday, height, and body weight and GPS positioning functionality to enhance the accuracy of data tracking across various sports activities,like pedometer for walking steps and miles. -2)Open Runmefit APP,click"Devices"-->"Device settings"-->turn on"Automatic measurement" -3)Ensure precise data accuracy by wearing the watch close to your skin, with the strap positioned one finger away from your wrist. -4)The wristband utilizes a three-axis accelerometer with a standard deviation of approximately 2%, which is considered normal. Keep in mind that most fitness trackers count steps through hand movement during walking, and there may be a slight delay in updating step count data. If you walk fewer than 20 steps within a timeframe, the step tracker may not count to minimize inaccuracies during periods of inactivity such as working or sleeping. -5) Swipe your finger down the top to update the “home” of Runmefit APP to sync the datas 
Q6.Why can’t I connect Bluetooth? The Bluetooth distance of fitness tracker is 10m(32.8 feet). If the Bluetooth connection is disconnected, Restart your phone by Runmefit APP-"Devices" ,after 5 seconds it will auto connect. If not, pls unbind the device in the app firstly and rebind it to restore the connection (no data usage will be affected. )If it still can’t work, delete “S5 ”pair information ,tap” +”search again and bind it . 
Q7.Unit settings (Celsius or Fahrenheit, imperial or metric): Open the APP, click [My], and click system settings to to customize the units. Alarm clock only can set in APP and sync to fitness tracker. 
Q8.The screen is stuck? Upgrading the APP to latest version . If the screen of your fitness tracker is stuck, pls click “Restore Factory Setting” on “Runmefit”APP and plug it into the USB port for charging then restore the screen and it become normal . 
Q9.Where can I see the record of heart rate etc? See all the record in Runmefit APP. Please click [Device settings] and turn on automatic measurement . See whether [Device]in APP is connected with “S5”. Swipe your finger down the top to update the “home” of Runmefit APP to sync the datas. Sleep dataONLY can see on APP(measured from 21:00pm to 9:00am). 
Q10.How to touch the screen of all sports mode and “more”-power off, factory reset for fitness tracker ? Long press the button for 3 seconds for enter and exit . 
More questions, pls see check the operation guide of "Questions and help " of APP or click on the order and click [Contact Seller] to reach out us.We are consistently available online to assist you.

aPlusContent.title: Product Description
aPlusContent.rawText:
Product Description
To get a satisfactory experience, you can do the following: 
1. Trouble turning on? If 5 seconds doesn't work, charge by inserting one wristband end with the metal piece into any USB source for 5 mins. Touch the button for 3 seconds to activate. 
2. Charging issues? It might be the wrong way! Successful charging triggers vibration and a charging icon. Check the manual or contact support for details. 
3. Notice incorrect time after your wristband's battery runs out and it shuts down? Simply charge it and connect to the app to synchronize with your phone's time. 
4. Device problems? Contact our one-on-one customer support for quick assistance. 
5. Before you proceed with the connection, take a moment to check your phone's Bluetooth settings for any existing paired watches. If you find any, delete the pairing information before initiating the new pairing process. 
Sedentary Reminder 
Switch on the Sedentary Alert function and set the alert time. Fitness tracker will vibrate and remind you to move or exercise after the set sedentary alert period passed. Balance work and leisure, and enjoy a happy work-life balance. 
Intelligent Reminders 
After connecting your fitness watch to the app and activating smart notifications, the watch will vibrate to remind you of any incoming messages/calls. You won't miss any important messages, whether you're busy or your phone isn't nearby. (Tips: it can not make calls or text back) 
Remote Photo Control 
Capture breathtaking selfies, group photos, or videos with a simple tap, ensuring you're always in the frame. 
Notification Alarms 
Customize up to 10 alarms on our sports watch using the app to suit your specific needs, such as waking up, sleeping, appointments, meetings, dinner, and more. Using it is as simple as long-pressing the touch key on the wristband for 2 seconds to enable/disable the alarm function. 
Simple Charging, Durable Battery 
With a built-in USB charger, this pedometer is incredibly convenient and eliminates the need to worry about lost chargers. Charging is as simple as pulling the watchband off clockwise and inserting the metal pins into a USB port. A two-hour charge can provide a week's worth of use. 
Product Dimensions 
Our watch straps are adjustable for both large and small wrists. The maximum circumference is 7.6 inches, and the minimum circumference is 5.4 inches. Fitness tracker for women men. 
Q1: About connection 
Please download our APP according to the user guide, open the APP, select "Device" at the bottom, then click "Bind Device" to enter the "Bind Device" page, select the watch Bluetooth in the list, and the connection will be successful. 
Q2: The time on the watch is inaccurate 
1) When the watch and App are successfully connected, the watch will synchronize the phone time. 
2) After the bracelet is depleted and shut down, leaving it alone for a long time will cause the time to be incorrect. After charging, connect the App to synchronize the time on your phone. 
Q3: The app can’t find the watch Bluetooth? 
1) Make sure your mobile phone system Bluetooth is turned on. 
2) Make sure that the watch is not connected to the mobile phone system Bluetooth. If it is connected, please disconnect from the system Bluetooth first, because the APP will automatically block devices connected to the system Bluetooth when searching. 
Q4: Heart rate detection is not accurate? 
Non-standard wearing methods will affect the measurement of heart rate signals; the correct measurement method is to lay your arms flat, relax and keep them still, and ensure that the bracelet is close to your wrist. 
Q5：Count Steps Accurately Guide 
Regarding the step counting, this fitness tracker has a built-in 3D sensor. It registers your steps when you swing your arm. Sometimes the data on device may displayed a little delayed. And it will reset itself if you walk continuously less than 40 steps. To test the accuracy of the pedometer, please walk casually and continuously up to 100 steps or more. 
Q6：SMS/Calls notifications 
Calls/SMS notification function works when the devicecon-nects to your smartphone via APP. 
Please note: Certain features may be affected if your device is disconnected or in "Do Not Disturb" mode.

aPlusContent.rawText:
From the manufacturer
1.47" Large HD AMOLED Display 
Amazfit Band 7 features a large 1.47” AMOLED display with 282 PPI, bringing you a clear and gorgeous visual experience. The viewable area is 112% bigger compared to Amazfit Band 5. 
With the Always-on Display, your band screen is always visible at a glance and always looks stunning. 
Upgraded Battery Life 
The 232 mAh battery has enough power to get you charged for up to 18 days with typical usage, so you can focus on your activities mind free. And the fitness tracker watch can even last up to 28 days in battery saver mode, 12 days with heavy usage. 
Test 3 Health Metrics in 1 Tap 
With the Amazfit Band 7 you can test your heart rate, blood-oxygen saturation, and stress level simultaneously in a single tap of the band, for a result in as fast as 45 seconds. So you can more quickly and easily understand your health condition without cycling through individual health apps. 
Monitor Your Sleep Quality 
Amazfit Band 7 can professionally interpret the sleep characteristics at each stage and analyze sleep quality, to help you adjust your sleep habits. It tracks your sleep quality through the light, deep, and REM sleep stages, and provides you with a sleep score to give you a holistic analysis of your sleep.

5-7 Days Battery Life

1. Please turn on the watch then tap the touch button to cycle through the menu and find the "Setting" icon.
